title: Enterprise Connectivity: collection suspension
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs collection suspension for collection suspension.

## Policy clause 1
The contract status is active.

## Policy clause 2
Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice maturity period plus collection grace period after the source invoice is issued.

## Policy clause 3
The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

## Policy clause 4
Add invoice maturity period and then collection grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

## Policy clause 5
Equality qualifies.

## Policy clause 6
The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

## Policy clause 7
Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

## Policy clause 8
An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

## Policy clause 9
Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

## Policy clause 10
Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Evidence condition 1
For collection suspension, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The contract status is active. The evidence consists of contract identifier, status. Correlate the same contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Evidence condition 2
For collection suspension, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice maturity period plus collection grace period after the source invoice is issued. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, invoice issue time. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Calendar boundary
Add invoice maturity period and then collection grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The authoritative anchor is invoice issue time when the source invoice is issued. The comparison uses the fixed current handling time; equality is included.

## Hypothetical maturity case
Consider hypothetical handling immediately before the collection boundary and exactly at it. The earlier handling produces an informational explanation without a status change. Equality satisfies the time condition; the contract and unpaid-invoice conditions remain necessary.

## Evidence condition 3
For collection suspension, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The evidence consists of contract identifier, payment restriction, evidence-event identifier, amount. Correlate the same contract identifier, evidence-event identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Fixed total collection period
Total collection period: The sum of invoice maturity period and collection grace period..

## Points of judgement
Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the invoice maturity period, collection grace period used by this rule.

## Record identity: collection suspension
The agent moves the contract from active to suspended. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.
